title: Preview Render
description: A single rendered piece of a preview. Most formats render as a single piece, but companion ad formats, multi-placement formats, and adaptive formats may render as multiple pieces.

render_id.description: Unique identifier for this render piece

preview_url.description: URL to the rendered preview HTML page that can be embedded in an iframe

placement_hint.description: Optional hint about where this piece should be placed (e.g., 'main', 'companion', 'banner')

media_type.description: MIME type of the preview content
